description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating  a token copy of Elenda that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Vampires, adding {5}.
Repeat.
